docs.text: Meanwhile, also, anyone ever feeling stuck on worldbuilding needs to just remember that this country features "the Rocky Mountains," "the Great Plains," "the Great Lakes" (of which the largest and northmost is "Lake Superior"), "the Great Salt Lake," and "the Grand Canyon"

It’s crazy how water-rich the east is compared to the west. Between the Great Lakes, the Finger Lakes, the Hudson and the Mississippi, the eastern portion of North America contains a significant fraction of all the fresh water in the world.

Years ago, while working with hydrogeoligists, I learned that the subcontinent divide is in Brookfield, Wisconsin. East of this point, water ultimately drains into Lake Michigan. West of that point, it drains ultimately into the Mississippi River. The more you know!
